scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.sync:db: node -e "import('./server/src/db/connection.js').then(async c => { await c.initDatabase(); console.log('Database Synced Successfully'); process.exit(0); });"
scripts.seed:db: node -e "import('./server/src/db/seedData.js').then(async s => { await s.resetAndSeedDatabase(); console.log('Database Seeded Successfully'); process.exit(0); });"
